title: Saw the sync so CTO’s post asking for 256 H200s on a 1-year lease. Is GPU capacity really this tight, or is it normal for a video model lab? [ i will not promote ]
content:
Saw a LinkedIn post from the CTO of sync labs (the lipsync/dubbing API, YC W24, did Wav2Lip back in the day). They want around 256 H200s or B300s, 32 nodes, 1-year minimum, and say big labs are taking all the capacity.

Two things I can't comprehend.

Fi
